name: Drôme
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: An IGP for wines of the Drôme. Across all the Drôme's vineyards, whatever their appellation, Grenache (38%) and Syrah (33%) are planted most, with Muscat Blanc, Carignan and Merlot far behind.
